336:t_005:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Yes... He will be here in about four minutes.」

336:t_005:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「It's $$欲深な金牛$$, $$ストラウス$$...!」

336:t_005:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「Why is the commander of all $$新地球皇国$$ forces coming here...!?」

336:t_005:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What do we do, $$ゼロ$$?」

336:t_005:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...It is dangerous to face a $$リアクター$$ with our current strength.」

336:t_005:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Fortunately, the townspeople and lab staff have evacuated. Fight at full strength until $$ストラウス$$ arrives, then withdraw!」

336:t_005:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I won't allow it...! I will dispose of you before the Supreme Commander arrives!」

336:t_005:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Then I will burn this facility, harboring those who defy the Empire, to the ground, and...」

336:t_006:1.en:
???
「...I tried to pick him off, but my aim was a little off.」

336:t_006:3.en:
???
「I can't leave an arsonist who sets other people's homes on fire alone...!」

336:t_007:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry I kept you waiting, everyone. $$クロウ・ブルースト$$ has arrived.」

336:t_007:2.en:
$n
「That's $$クロウ・ブルースト$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$揺れる天秤$$...!」

336:t_007:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
(That cynical air is kind of attractive...)

336:t_007:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, $$クロウ$$! At last we meet again!」

336:t_007:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Shut up, $$サルディアス$$. I never wanted to see the likes of you again.」

336:t_007:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I figured as much~.」

336:t_007:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I'd like to say that, but it isn't true. I've been waiting to see you again so I can repay you for what happened on $$翠の地球$$.」

336:t_007:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... That sounds rather dangerous.」

336:t_007:10.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We've been waiting for you, chief!」

336:t_007:11.en:
$$桂$$
「You bastard...! Showing up at a time like this is way too flashy!」

336:t_007:12.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Knowing that man, he's probably drowning in debt as usual.」

336:t_007:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's too bad for you. I've paid every last bit back, and I'm a free man now.」

336:t_007:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...While you were all fighting on $$蒼の地球$$, I was fighting $$サイデリアル$$ on $$翠の地球$$.」

336:t_007:17.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Were you with $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$?」

336:t_007:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah, I was. After the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed, I sent the Chief the $$サイデリアル$$ data I got there.」

336:t_007:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That cleared my million G debt. As a bonus, she let me use the 《$$ＣＤＳ$$》 all I want for a while.」

336:t_007:21.en:
$$ノイン$$
「That is even harder to believe.」

336:t_007:24.en:
$$研究員$$
「It seems you had a hard time on $$翠の地球$$, $$クロウ$$. I apologize for doing this over comms, but please accept my thanks for your efforts.」

336:t_007:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah, I did. After all, when I was transported there, my machine was an $$アクシオ・スコートＳＰ$$.」

336:t_007:26.en:
$$研究員$$
「Returning must have been difficult too. I'll play the video message the Doctor prepared in case you came to the lab while she was away.」

336:t_008:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「You did well, $$クロウ$$. First, I'm glad you made it back safely.」

336:t_008:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... You're being awfully sweet for the Chief.」

336:t_008:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ data you sent was very useful. Let me thank you again.」

336:t_008:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's not like you. I just did my job faithfully.」

336:t_008:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「You have a million G left on your debt.」

336:t_009:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「W-w-w-what the hell!? You said my debt was paid in full when I sent you the data!」

336:t_009:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm sure you're surprised to hear this.」

336:t_009:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「But sending the upgraded $$リ・ブラスタ$$ to you across the dimensional barrier cost quite a lot.」

336:t_009:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「The total was a million G.」

336:t_009:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hold on! Isn't that a business expense!?」

336:t_009:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「I can picture your face as you desperately make excuses.」

336:t_009:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... If you have a complaint, take it up with yourself for getting your $$スコートＳＰ$$ shot down.」

336:t_009:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well then... I look forward to the day we meet again.」

336:t_010:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm back in debt the moment I return to $$蒼の地球$$!?」

336:t_011:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$揺れる天秤$$! Do not talk about money on the battlefield!」

336:t_011:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Battle is the supreme game, staking all your wisdom and power and setting your soul and body ablaze! Yet a man like you, with vulgar talk of money...!」

336:t_011:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't go forcing your way of doing things on me.」

336:t_012:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I'm the million G man... It seems that phrase fits me perfectly.」

336:t_012:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then I'll do it! Bring on the arrows, guns, or debts, you goddamn bastards!!」

336:t_012:3.en:
$n
「I heard the $$揺れる天秤$$... activates his $$スフィア$$ through a strong will...」

336:t_012:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So... it's his will to pay off his debts...」

336:t_013:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I feel for you, living like that.」

336:t_013:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Today I'll back you up in place of $$デュオ$$ and $$ロックオン$$.」

336:t_014:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Work hard, $$クロウ$$! It's a long road to a million G!」

336:t_014:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... I've done this before. I know that without you telling me.」

336:t_014:2.en:
$$モーム$$
「That is so uncool, $$クロウ$$!」

336:t_014:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So what... You're saying he's racked up a million G in debt over and over!?」

336:t_014:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「He pays it back over and over, then ends up in debt again... I can't tell whether that's impressive or not...」

336:t_014:5.en:
$n
「Even in defeat, he rises again with an indomitable fighting spirit...」

336:t_014:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I think you've got the wrong idea, $n...」

336:t_014:8.en:
$n
「Let's do this, $$クロウ$$! I'll fight too!」

336:t_014:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks, $$いがみ合う双子$$. But from today on, we're teammates.」

336:t_014:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just call me $$クロウ$$. I'll call you $n too.」
